body: Meet The Cozy Canine Cruiser, a custom-built camper van designed for adventurers and their furry companions. This unique conversion features a spacious interior with two dog crates, a light wood aesthetic, and all the comforts of home. It boasts a luxurious queen bed, an indoor shower with a wet-bath style toilet, and an outdoor shower for rinsing off after a day of exploration.

The kitchen is equipped with a double burner induction cooktop, a stainless steel sink, and a large fridge/freezer, making meal prep a breeze. The van ensures year-round comfort with premium insulation, a diesel-powered cabin heater, and a 12v AC unit.

With ample storage, including overhead hanging bags and under-counter cabinets, plus convenient amenities like recessed LED lights, a smart TV, and a swivel table, The Cozy Canine Cruiser showcases the perfect blend of style and functionality for an adventurous lifestyle.
